question: Do UP stride overrides select a different fetch destination or avoid the persistent shader readback-history obligation?

scope.sharedPath: ADD88 -> ADC48 -> AD150 or ADA38; retained VS generation and selected variant matter.
scope.qualification: Static conditional UP-to-persistent/readback witness; no observed IndexedUp dominance, live resource-generation history or broader consume admission.

dependencies.use: Owns shared dirty selector, masked cache key, hit/busy and persistent/inline guards.
Owns the exact transformation, sparse writes, template and byte identity contract.
Owns same-resource clone activation, C*(t), readback and later Original coherence.
Owns stride restoration, dirty-helper order, allocation units and geometry lifetime.
Owns mode-generated dirty80000, local-mode variants and complete selected side effects.

currentEvidence.entryAndStride: IndexedBuffer uses existing G30F0..30FF. IndexedUp A3568 reads entrySP+84: frame176 and postframe slot260, moves to r9 and calls A3048@A35AC. NonindexedUp A3000 moves entryr7 to r6 and calls A2B58@A3020. Lowerers save G30F0@A3094/A2B78, temporarily write low8(stride>>2)@A309C/A2B7C, add dirty80000@A30B8/A2BA4 iff byte differs from G2E38 and VS is nonnull, then call ADD88@A312C/A2C24. They restore the byte@A32E4/A2DDC after dirty helpers, before C588/geometry takes. Slot/frame/stride numbers here are decimal.
currentEvidence.keyDistinction: G2E38 cached byte is a local dirty trigger, not a declaration tag. ADC48 checks Rv=VS+0x1A0*v: wordRv+28==wordVD+30 and both masked64 stride XORs against VD+20/+28 equal0. UP replaces byte0, the most significant byte of the first BE64 qword; streams1..15 stay current. A masked-off difference can request dirty but hit; equal cached byte does not prove tag equality. Hit skips patch/ID/tag/stride-record/busy work but still copies stream qwords to G2E38/+2E40.
currentEvidence.selector: No UP-specific arm forces inline. NoPS primaryv=1 iff VS+368&20, otherwise0; livePS selects0. G2ABE80, linkage mismatchr27, or G2ABC80 select allocated copy. With dirty80000, VD nonnull, VS+368&40 clear and persistent guards, ADC48@AE108 may hit or reusable-miss AD150@ADD0C. Busy primary falls to ADA38@AE13C. Effective/saved low3 mismatch plus VSbit20 can request second ADC48v1@AE168; busy second has no second inline fallback there. Record stamp+40 is distinct from tag+28. Restore of stream0 does not undo persistent code/cache stores.
currentEvidence.conditionalWitness: Same retained effect VS, UP stride20 bytes and cached byte4 produces temporary5/dirty80000 before geometry allocation. With livePS,mode4,r27=0,inline bits clear,validVD,VSbits20/40 clear,incompatible primarytag,reusable stamp and nonempty valid patch list, ADD88 -> ADC48 -> AD150 writes persistent C+wordM0. Accepted same-device F808 clone shares/AddRefs that VS through Q+4 and can reach44E8 ->1C40 ->62D28 ->nonnull94480, which copies its metadata and all persistent code bytes. This is a conditional static witness, not an observed instance.
currentEvidence.hostBoundary: CheckVertexFetchPatch uses a local UP override/effective dirtyLow; IndexedBuffer supplies none. It checks bounds and a conservative possible persistent miss without modeling r27/stamp, so VertexFetch does not prove a particular Original writes C. Shared native_consume_dirty_vertex_fetch defaults false; base/tiled/dirty defaults and outer guards remain separate. HostPatchedVertexDigest/ReadNativeDrawShaderWords derive current draw identity/words from templates; they do not replay guest persistent history. ReadNativeDrawShaderWords requires VS+PS and vertex-only variant1 lacks that patch model, so broader noPS classification is not host draw coverage.

replacementObligations: C*(t) includes creation bytes plus every ordered persistent sparse write from UP, IndexedBuffer and retained Originals in the same VS generation. Preserve variants, duplicate/overlapping destinations and untouched bytes. Compatible hits retain older code; busy/forced-inline writes affect only their copy. Equal pointers after reinitialization do not identify the same generation.

Current stride, G2E38 or last key cannot reconstruct history. Readback-only scoped materialize/copy/restore needs exact C*(t), metadata/untouched-byte preservation, disjoint/protected ranges and exclusion of concurrent/reentrant observers; the copy alone needs no record/tag/stride/stamp/VD-ID stores.

Durable materialization also needs future Original cache/code coherence: stale prefix state can accept changed code and skip AD150. Maintain logical cache history and synchronize/intercept/refuse surviving Original boundaries. Retained SetStreamSource@FC08 independently reads G2E38; readback alone does not license omitting it.

Keep current-draw host template lowering, retained guest bytes, dirty-clear/staging effects and actual native draw coverage as separate obligations. A noPS native selector is insufficient to admit a host helper that requires PS.
guards: The temporary byte is low8(stride>>2):20 bytes becomes5 and1024 becomes0. Allocation q=low32(count*stride)>>2 is a separate unit calculation.
Static structure can explain a possible UP dirty/persistent path; actual fallback dominance needs an ordered runtime state/generation observation, which is outside this packet.
UP restoration and geometry copy do not create a new VS allocation or discharge readback history. No runtime consume or broader dirty-fetch admission follows.
conclusion: UP adds a temporary stride-driven dirty request but reaches the same persistent fetch patch and variant machinery as IndexedBuffer. The retained per-generation ordered readback and later Original coherence requirements therefore apply to persistent UP patches too.
